faq.dap: Orders are packed and handed to the carrier within 1-3 business days. Delivery to most US addresses then takes 7-15 business days. Shipping is free on every order.

faq.hoi: How can I track my order?
faq.dap: As soon as your order ships we email you a tracking link. You can also look it up any time on our Track your order page with your order number and email. Tracking can take 2-3 days to show movement.

faq.hoi: Can I change or cancel my order?
faq.dap: You can cancel for a full refund any time before your order ships. If you spot a mistake in your address, email us within 12 hours of ordering and we'll fix it before it ships.

faq.hoi: What is your return and refund policy?
faq.dap: You have 30 days from delivery. Wrong size: we send the new size or refund you. Change of mind: email us within 30 days for a partial refund to keep the shoes, or a full refund once the unworn pair is returned. Full details on our Refund Policy.

faq.hoi: My item arrived damaged or isn't what I ordered. What now?
faq.dap: Email us your order number and a photo of the problem. We'll send a replacement or refund you in full, and you don't need to send anything back.

faq.hoi: How can I reach customer support?
faq.dap: Email support@mellowstep.com or use our contact form. We usually reply within 24 hours.
